Olivia Tan: Quick partner shoutout — SynapseAI signed a co-sell agreement and will list their new 'EdgeKit' product on GCP Marketplace next week. We've finished Redwood Dedicated integration tests for the pilot. Huge team effort :tada:

Ben Choi: Amazing — congrats!! Who's taking sales follow-up?

Maya Alvarez: I'll own the tech outreach for the pilot. SSO config and certify docs are ready. Ping me with customer IDs and access scopes.

Jorge Rojas: Eng ran load tests on Dedicated; EdgeKit runtimes hit our p95 SLOs. Left notes in ticket #12345. Need to finalize autoscaling policy and a small quantization tweak.

integrations-bot: Marketplace listing task created: TASK-8894 — owner: Maya Alvarez — due: 2030-09-07

Olivia Tan: @Ben can you coordinate the co-sell kickoff with their AE team? Also, do we want a joint case study draft during pilot or wait until GA?

Ben Choi: On it. I'll loop in Gabe and schedule a joint call next Tuesday. Let's draft a short case study during the pilot — helps marketing + sales.

Maya Alvarez: Sending README, test vectors, and quickstart to Synapse contact (synapse@partner.com) now. Also added a small `autoscale` snippet for Dedicated in the repo.

Jorge Rojas: Note on quantization: EdgeKit uses mixed-int8 profiles; I'll add recommended config to the docs before pilot kickoff.

Amir Singh: Heads-up from comms — I'll prepare a short internal announcement and a one-pager for sales enablement. Want to sync on messaging tomorrow morning.

Olivia Tan: Perfect. Big win — this is SynapseAI's first partner listing optimized for edge inference workloads, and the Dedicated integration makes it a strong enterprise play. :rocket:

Ben Choi: :confetti_ball: Nice work team. Small ask — please add any customer-facing performance numbers to the shared folder so sales has something to cite.

Maya Alvarez: Done — perf matrix uploaded: https://redwood.app/drive/edgekit-perf

integrations-bot: Deployment hook executed for dedicated-integration: deploy-789 OK

Olivia Tan: Thanks everyone. I'm adding follow-up items to the partner playbook and will post the final PRD link once the PR is merged.
